items.title: Sextant
items.blurb: Look up and get star data in your field of view — AR/VR sky exploration.
body: An augmented/virtual-reality system for exploring the sky: point the device and get information on the stars in front of you.
Browser-based demo built under time pressure. Second place at the Cursor × Tec Hackathon.

items.title: Q-Pay
items.blurb: P2P lending that cuts friction when signing promissory notes.
body: A peer-to-peer lending app designed to reduce friction around signing promissory notes (pagarés).
We built a waitlist of 100 people and reached the INNOVATECH semifinals, accidentally going up against local startups.

items.title: Shoot AI
items.blurb: AI image advisory for photoshoots: prep, outfits, and a Live Shoot camera guide.
body: Built at the Cursor Buildathon San Salvador (24 h), representing Guatemala.
An AI image-advisory agency for social shoots: proportions, outfits, and Live Shoot — on-camera coaching with reinforcement learning and catalog scraping.

items.title: Q-Threats
items.blurb: Review legal decrees and bills, and map relationships between state entities.
body: Selected among 1,200+ applicants from Latin America for Hack@Latam.
A platform to validate decrees and congressional bills in Guatemala, plus mapping relationships and agreements between government entities — transparency and corruption track.

items.title: Aprendi
items.blurb: Adaptive learning: personalized paths and Linux labs based on live performance.
body: 1st place at the UFM Computer Science Hackathon 2026 (team of 3, with Qubity).
An education platform that adapts content to user progress and includes interactive Linux labs. Product still evolving.

items.title: Agent Builder
items.blurb: Build and deploy AI agents with LLMs, RAG, and live data.
body: Top 5 finalist at Atom Dev Day 2026: ~8-hour sprint, team of 3.
A platform to assemble agents (e.g. sales) with LLM + RAG and real-time data integration.

items.title: Astro Tracker
items.blurb: Simulate asteroid impacts with NASA data and estimate physical and economic damage.
body: 48-hour MVP (team of 6) for the NASA Space Apps Challenge.
Interactive simulation with NASA APIs, FITS data, and impact estimates — the build behind the Global Connection honorific mention.

items.title: Videntia
items.blurb: AI visual analysis: human-readable image descriptions for accessibility and research.
body: School project featured at Expokinal 2025. Team of 6; ~1-week build.
Turns images into readable descriptions using computer vision and LLMs.

items.title: Unmask AI
items.blurb: Extract and analyze visual data with OCR, LLMs, and automated deep search.
body: ~3-day solo MVP: OCR + LLMs to read visuals and kick off automated deep search on what was extracted.
